Alger, 8 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L: Algiers, October 8, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Algerian subsidiary of the tech group Huawei will present its latest solutions dedicated to the energy transition at the KAHRABA 2026 Expo. The event will take place from October 13 to 15, 2026 at the Algiers Exhibition Center (SAFEX).
Présentation de solutions technologiques: Presentation of technological solutions for the energy transition
Durant cette manifestation de trois jour: During this three-day event, the company will showcase its technological innovations at the Palestine Pavilion. The solutions presented aim to support digital efficiency and energy development across several major technological axes.
Les démonstrations porteront notamment s: Demonstrations will focus in particular on the digitalization of the electrical grid, the deployment of smart microgrids, and the implementation of next-generation green data centers.
Un espace interactif permettra aux profe: An interactive space will allow professionals and visitors to speak with experts and attend live presentations. The stated objective of the operator is to contribute to the development of smarter and more sustainable infrastructures on the national market.
Localisation du stand au Pavillon de la: Booth location at the Palestine Pavilion within SAFEX in Algiers.
Focus sur la transformation numérique de: Focus on the digital transformation of electricity and smart microgrid technologies.
Exposition de solutions de centres de do: Exhibition of next-generation green data center solutions.
Organisation d'une expérience interactiv: Organization of an interactive experience with live demonstrations and discussions with experts.
